svg.title: izzoel's Kalimantan contribution forest
svg.desc: 2025-10-19 — 2026-10-22. 756 contributions across 132 active days. One tile per day; larger tropical trees represent higher GitHub contribution levels. A river and a wooden stilt house evoke Kalimantan.

g.text: 132 active days · 25 on the busiest day
Each tile is a day. Each tree grows with your contributions.
